ModMetaData.name: Star Wars: Bad Batch
ModMetaData.author: Alp
ModMetaData.description:
Step into the Star Wars universe with new content that brings the style of the Bad Batch into RimWorld.
Content includes: • Textures faithful to the series with RimWorld compatibility • Support for the latest versions of the game
A fitting choice for anyone wanting to bring the galaxy far, far away into RimWorld.
